text:
lina: pd-bot just fired: PagerDuty incident INC-2334 for service=embeddings-prod-canary — multiple 503s detected on /v1/embeddings, p50 latency spike. Paging oncall.
pd-bot: @ryan oncall notified (pagerduty). escalation policy: embeddings-prod -> eng-oncall -> eng-sre
lina: pushing logs: `10.10.32.7 embed-worker | ERR 503 upstream read` seen across 3 canary instances
devops-bot: alert rule: canary_5xx_rate > 5% for 2m. Triggered on cluster eu-west-1
ryan: ack-ing the page. I'll take initial triage. @sam can you shadow for rollback if needed? :raised_hands:
sam: here. I can prep rollback and start traffic-split check.
lina: initial customer reports: small number of customers using embeddings in prod are seeing failures and retries. Not widespread but reproducible against canary.
ryan: pulling metrics... I see error spike starting at 2334506700, correlates with canary rollout tag=v2.3.8-canary
jess: adding note: recent PR #4872 changed request throttling logic in embed-worker, landed in canary
maria: confirming config: throttling config changed from 500->200 req/s per pod in that PR
ryan: hypothesis: new throttling + slightly slower kernel leads to connection resets -> 503. Plan: remove canary from traffic, trigger immediate rollback for canary pods, and re-route traffic to stable.
sam: commands ready:
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings-service -n prod --to-revision=42
kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-service-canary -n prod --replicas=0
redwood-router set-weight embeddings-service:v2.3.8-canary 0
```
ryan: executing scale and router change now.
devops-bot: traffic split change applied: canary weight -> 0% (id=rt-99123)
lina: load on stable looks normal, 5xxs drop to baseline after 30s
pd-bot: incident INC-2334 acknowledged by ryan
sam: starting rollback rollout undo; monitoring pod restarts
jess: rollback confirmed: new pods running stable image v2.3.7
maria: config note: throttling back to 500 req/s restored on stable
ryan: status update: customer impact reduced, errors dropping. Keeping incident open for 30m monitoring.
lina: collecting a list of affected request ids for customer support: `req-5f4a*` pattern
sam: I will run canary test job against v2.3.8 in staging to repro the throttling failure with CPU pressure
jess: creating PR to add a safety knob and revert the throttling change in canary to 500 until we validate (PR draft)
maria: logging and alerts: will add a secondary alert for throttling config mismatches between stable/canary
ryan: will close PD incident when 30m passes with no reoccurrence. For now, handoff to ops monitoring: @lina please keep an eye for customer escalations.
lina: on it. Notifying support team with affected req ids and mitigation steps. cc: @support
pd-bot: incident INC-2334 status: mitigated -> monitoring
sam: postmortem owners: jess (code), maria (config), sam (deployment), ryan (oncall) — will draft within 48h
ryan: thanks team. Good coordination. :white_check_mark:
lina: saving logs and timestamps, will add to the incident binder and schedule a 1hr follow-up call.
pd-bot: INC-2334 will auto-resolve if no more alerts in 30m. Current state: monitoring.
